item.title: Future Reveals ‘The Real Me’ Cover Art & Track List: ‘Who U Think Featured on My Album’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music update. We're just days away from the release of Future's highly anticipated album, The Real Me. The rapper shared the official cover art and track list on Instagram, and we've got the details.
[Short music transition]
Host: The cover art features Future shirtless, with a menacing stare and freshly dyed blonde twists against a black backdrop. He also teased that there will be guest features on the album, but we'll have to wait until Friday to find out who they are.
[Short music transition]
Host: The Real Me boasts 22 tracks, including the previously released single "Radio". Other song titles include "California Girls", "Fukk a Interview", "Snow in Skyami", and "2018". This could be Future's 12th No. 1 album on the Billboard 200, following a streak of nine solo albums that reached the top spot.
[Short music transition]
Host: Future's been keeping busy, recently ending his beef with Drake and collaborating on the song "Ran to Atlanta", which peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100. He also teamed up with Tyla for the FIFA World Cup 2026 anthem "Game Time", which they performed live at the World Cup's Opening Ceremony.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest on Future's upcoming album. Stay tuned for more music updates, and get ready for The Real Me to drop on Friday. Thanks for listening!
